content: {"action":"answer","requirement_ids":["req-segments"],"answer":{"claims":[{"statement":"报告事实:AMD 在 FY2023 10-K 中披露其有四个可报告分部。","temporal_basis":"reported_actual","period_context":"FY2023 10-K(财年截至 2023-12-30)","citations":[{"context_id":"ev-4f68c8e71937ae913fc7e849","block_id":"block-000072-8555b0ea","quote":"Our four reportable segments are:","label":"四个可报告分部引导句 (block-000072-8555b0ea)"}]},{"statement":"报告事实:Data Center(数据中心)分部主要包括用于数据中心的服务器 CPU、GPU、APU、DPU、FPGA、SmartNIC、AI 加速器和 Adaptive SoC 产品。","temporal_basis":"reported_actual","period_context":"FY2023 10-K(财年截至 2023-12-30)","citations":[{"context_id":"ev-4f68c8e71937ae913fc7e849","block_id":"block-000073-e71f5008","quote":"•the Data Center segment, which primarily includes server CPUs, GPUs, APUs, DPUs, FPGAs, SmartNICs, AI accelerators and Adaptive SoC products for data centers;","label":"Data Center 分部 (block-000073-e71f5008)"}]},{"statement":"报告事实:Client(客户端)分部主要包括用于台式机、笔记本和手持个人电脑的 CPU、APU 和芯片组。","temporal_basis":"reported_actual","period_context":"FY2023 10-K(财年截至 2023-12-30)","citations":[{"context_id":"ev-4f68c8e71937ae913fc7e849","block_id":"block-000074-31027a3a","quote":"•the Client segment, which primarily includes CPUs, APUs, and chipsets for desktop, notebook and handheld personal computers;","label":"Client 分部 (block-000074-31027a3a)"}]},{"statement":"报告事实:Gaming(游戏)分部主要包括独立 GPU、半定制 SoC 产品和开发服务。","temporal_basis":"reported_actual","period_context":"FY2023 10-K(财年截至 2023-12-30)","citations":[{"context_id":"ev-4f68c8e71937ae913fc7e849","block_id":"block-000075-f6ae3e20","quote":"•the Gaming segment, which primarily includes discrete GPUs, semi-custom SoC products and development services; and","label":"Gaming 分部 (block-000075-f6ae3e20)"}]},{"statement":"报告事实:Embedded(嵌入式)分部主要包括嵌入式 CPU、GPU、APU、FPGA、SOM 和 Adaptive SoC 产品。","temporal_basis":"reported_actual","period_context":"FY2023 10-K(财年截至 2023-12-30)","citations":[{"context_id":"ev-4f68c8e71937ae913fc7e849","block_id":"block-000076-25664a5d","quote":"•the Embedded segment, which primarily includes embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, SOMs, and Adaptive SoC products.","label":"Embedded 分部 (block-000076-25664a5d)"}]},{"statement":"报告事实:All Other 是一个附加类别,10-K 明确说明它不是可报告分部。推断(非原文):因此 All Other 不属于上述四个可报告分部之一。本次回读的片段未描述 All Other 的具体内容。","temporal_basis":"reported_actual","period_context":"FY2023 10-K(财年截至 2023-12-30)","citations":[{"context_id":"ev-a7fa6b067189aea6fea55b96","block_id":"block-000077-0cf606c9","quote":"In addition to these reportable segments, we have an All Other category, which is not a reportable segment.","label":"All Other 非可报告分部 (block-000077-0cf606c9)"}]}],"model_claimed_coverage":"claimed_complete","coverage_note":"已完整回读 10-K 中列出可报告分部的引导句、四个分部项目符号(block-000072 至 block-000076)以及 All Other 的说明句(block-000077)。四个分部的列表完整。All Other 的具体构成不在本次问题范围内,也未回读。","unresolved_questions":[]}}
